title: Policy-selected triage receipts update actual readers
description: ADR-071 D07 source observation. Use copied approved receipts outside the selected home and a launch-time failed run. Edit, restore, remove and recreate admitted files and switch the actual policy directory. Assert canonical query revisions and visible prerequisite state without provider execution or UI/cache/SQLite injection.

proofTargets.claim: The production transport module initializes alongside selected triage source observation before actual browser reads.
Actual admitted receipt replacement changes the mounted triage prerequisite and exact byte restoration recovers without Refresh.
Removing and recreating an admitted artifact invalidates and recovers the actual mounted query.
A real policy switch selects its new receipt directory; unselected and retired sources do not invalidate it.
The same app and connection perform observed read-only triage requests with no analysis, feedback, decision or provider command.

module-load.intent: Initialize the production transport entry without starting a worker.

module-load-check.intent: Reject a source-observation import cycle before browser validation.

prove.intent: Observe actual selected receipt writes on the mounted triage panel.

receiptChangeAndRecovery.intent: Check actual byte changes and recovery without a manual Refresh.

receiptRemovalAndRecreation.intent: Check actual artifact removal and recreation.

policySwitchRetiresOldSource.intent: Check selection ownership after the real policy switch.

readOnlyNoProviderCommands.intent: Check observed reads and zero mutating commands.
